description: A professional dermatologist-inspired skincare routine designed to provide daily and weekly care for radiant skin.
estimated_time: 30 minutes per day, 1 hour every week

morning_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare skin for the day.
Balance skin's pH levels and provide initial hydration.

morning_steps.action: Applying serum containing Vitamin C or Hyaluronic Acid
morning_steps.purpose: Target specific concerns like hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and dehydration.
Lock in hydration for the day ahead.

night_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare skin for nighttime treatments.

night_steps.action: Exfoliating once a week using chemical exfoliants like AHAs or BHAs
night_steps.purpose: Remove dead skin cells and promote cell turnover.

night_steps.action: Applying retinol or a retinoid product
night_steps.purpose: Stimulate collagen production and reduce the appearance of fine lines.

night_steps.action: Moisturizing with richer formulas suitable for nighttime use
night_steps.purpose: Provide deep hydration and support skin repair while you sleep.

do: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water
dont: Over-exfoliate, which can lead to irritation and dryness
common_mistakes: Using too many products at once, leading to overloading the skin with active ingredients
Ignoring sunscreen use even on cloudy days
best_products_categories: Moisturizers suitable for your specific skin type (oily, dry, combination)
Exfoliating products appropriate for your skin's condition

expected_results.2_weeks: Improved hydration and reduced surface-level imperfections like blackheads.
expected_results.1_month: Increased skin elasticity and a more even texture due to consistent exfoliation and retinol use.
expected_results.3_months: Significant improvement in fine lines, wrinkles, and skin tone with continued adherence to the routine.

expert_tips: Patch test new products before incorporating them into your daily routine
Monitor skin response closely and adjust as necessary
